execution.objective: Restore the complete Member Dashboard surface coherently, including its Community preview tab and complete EN/VI/ZH localization, while preserving existing identity and invitation functionality and unrelated repository work.
pre_mutation_preservation_gate: Record branch, HEAD, complete porcelain status, and all tracked diffs.
Create a preservation snapshot outside the repository of the complete pre-existing dirty and untracked working-tree state, with a manifest and SHA-256 checksums.
Verify the snapshot can be read and its checksums match before any application mutation.
Preserve the existing MemberHub.tsx changes, including sent-invitation history and deletion functionality, without reverting or replacing them.
Do not claim the historical post-corruption fix set is complete; record unresolved forensic uncertainty.
scope_requirements: Restore the eighth Community tab and its dashboard preview content.
Use the recoverable historical SllCommunityPreview presentation as the reference, retaining preview-only behavior.
Add the Community tab translation key in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
Audit all visible Member Dashboard text for EN/VI/ZH localization, including hardcoded labels.
Preserve existing dashboard behavior and current identity/invitation restoration.
Do not add Matrix connectivity, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, or chat embedding.
required_checks: Diff review proving existing MemberHub functionality is retained.
Localization key parity and visible-string audit for EN, VI, and ZH.
Isolated candidate build that does not invoke the global project build or modify the live workspace.
Targeted tests and TypeScript comparison against the exact recorded baseline where safely reproducible.
Founder visual verification of the complete dashboard in EN, VI, and ZH.
invariants: No application mutation before steward review and a separate committed activation record.
No changes outside the exact three application mutation paths.
No backend, server, database, Supabase, RLS, identity API, membership, financial, or deployment changes.
No Matrix or Element integration activation.
No reset, stash, clean, prune, backup deletion, or overwriting unrelated work.
No commit, push, pull request merge, publication, or deployment under this authority.
Stop if preservation snapshot integrity or isolated build safety cannot be established.
execution.verification_profile: PRESERVATION_SNAPSHOT; EXACT_THREE_PATH_SCOPE; MEMBER_DASHBOARD_LOCALIZATION; COMMUNITY_PREVIEW_ONLY; ISOLATED_BUILD; FOUNDER_VISUAL_VERIFICATION; NO_DEPLOYMENT

forbidden_surface: All other application and repository paths

test_definition: Verify the complete Member Dashboard in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
Verify all eight tabs, including Community, render and remain navigable.
Verify Community remains a preview and exposes no Matrix destination or live integration.
Verify existing identity and invitation functionality remains intact.
Review isolated build and test evidence before any separate release decision.
